tools.name: funding_events
tools.description: List funding events ordered by announcement date, newest first. Filter by round, amount range, company HQ country, industry group, or a specific company id. Costs one credit per returned record.

tools.name: acquisitions
tools.description: List acquisition and merger events ordered by announcement date, newest first. Filter by payment type, deal amount range, merger flag, or a company that is the acquirer or target. Costs one credit per returned record.

tools.name: exec_moves
tools.description: List executive appointment, promotion, departure, and transition events ordered by announcement date, newest first. Filter by company, person, role seniority, move type, or a time window. Costs one credit per returned record.

tools.name: investors
tools.description: Search and filter investor records by keyword, type, HQ country, or exact domain. Costs one credit per returned record.

tools.description: List the workspace's account watchlists with member counts. Free.

tools.description: Return one watchlist with its resolved company members. Free.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "funding_events" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
